title: Eaterior v1.9.0

format.description: "eaterior" is the identifier written since 1.8.0. "eateryplan" is the pre-1.8 name of the same format and stays accepted when reading.

schemaVersion.description: All 1.x documents remain valid. Legacy CafePlan 1.x files are converted with `eaterior migrate`.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag for names and labels.

externalRefs.description: Links to records in any number of external systems. Each (system, id) pair is unique in the plan.

id.description: Identifier, unique within the whole plan (checked by the semantic validator).

point.description: Point in floor units. Origin top-left, x to the right, y downwards.

style.description: Optional per-object style override. Clients should prefer their own theme.

rotationDeg.description: Degrees, clockwise positive. Pivot: rect = rectangle centre, ellipse = (cx, cy), polygon = centre of the bounding box of its points, path = centre of the bounding box of every coordinate written in its commands (end points and control points; arc radii ignored).

realWorldScale.description: Optional. Only set when the scale is known; never invent it.

coordinateSpace.description: Virtual coordinate system of the floor. Width/height keep the real aspect ratio (e.g. 1000 x 562.5 for a 16:9 drawing). Clients scale to fit the screen.

background.description: Original drawing placed under the plan, in floor units.

url.description: Relative or absolute URI of the file.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file content.

kind.description: Device type. ecology_unit = kitchen exhaust ecology unit (grease / smoke / odour filtration before discharge); air_handling_unit = AHU; heat_recovery_unit = heat recovery ventilator (HRV/ERV); fan_coil; air_curtain (above a door).

coveredZoneIds.description: Zones served by the device (same floor).

externalDeviceId.description: ID in an external BMS/IoT system. Not a credential. Kept for compatibility; prefer externalRefs, which supports several systems.

ratedCapacityW.description: Rated capacity in watts. Never inferred from images.

airflowDirectionDeg.description: Optional supply direction (degrees, clockwise, 0 = +x). Visual hint only.

performance.description: Rated / design values of the device (all optional). Used for ventilation, load and energy checks; values come from the data sheet or the mechanical design.

airflowM3h.description: Air volume flow, m³/h (supply or extract, whichever the device moves).

freshAirM3h.description: Outdoor (fresh) air part of the flow, m³/h.

filterClass.description: Filter class or stages, e.g. "ISO ePM1 70%" or "metal + ESP + active carbon".

heightMeters.description: Mounting height in metres (physical, independent of plan units).

externalSensorId.description: ID in an external IoT system. Not a credential. Kept for compatibility; prefer externalRefs, which supports several systems.

associatedDeviceId.description: climateDevice this sensor belongs to (e.g. a thermostat's unit).

extensions.description: Application-specific or forward-compatible data. Keys must be namespaced (e.g. 'acme.priceTier'). Clients ignore unknown keys and preserve them on save.

sourceAssetId.description: Asset the plan was traced from (image_import).

tool.description: Free-form name/version of the tool or model that generated the plan.

notes.description: Uncertainties or assumptions recorded during generation.

label.description: Text annotation (room names, notes) or a dimension line.

fontSize.description: Floor units. Clients may clamp for readability.

valueMeters.description: dimension: real length the drawing states. Used to derive realWorldScale.

appearance.description: Semantic look of an object: what it is made of and its colours. Renderers decide how to draw it (textures, shading, symbols). All fields are optional; omitted fields use the renderer's defaults. Use `style` only for low-level fill/stroke overrides.

color.description: Main colour (floor base, table top, upholstery, wall paint …).

accentColor.description: Secondary colour (second tile colour, cushions, trim …).

floor.description: Zones only: floor finish. tile_hexagon = hexagonal tiles; tile_subway = rectangular metro tiles in running bond; epoxy = seamless resin floor.

tableSetting.description: Tables only: what is laid at each seat.

roof.description: Pergolas only: roof type. slatted = open rafters; louvered = adjustable aluminium blades (bioclimatic); glass; fabric = retractable awning; solid. Use color for the frame and accentColor for the roof.

style.description: Design style. Tables: classic, modern, rustic, industrial, bistro, scandinavian. Sofas and armchairs: classic, modern, chesterfield, scandinavian. Parasols: classic (alternating panels), striped, scalloped, solid, cantilever (side pole). Renderers choose details per style. Rugs: persian (medallion), kilim, moroccan (trellis), striped, geometric, shag, jute, floral, bordered, abstract, chevron, braided (coiled); round or oval with an ellipse shape, rectangular or square with a rect.

tileSizeCm.description: Zones only: tile / slab size in cm (tile_square, tile_checker, tile_hexagon, tile_subway length, stone, marble). Renderers draw the pattern at this real size.

plankWidthCm.description: Zones only: plank / strip width in cm for wood floors and terrace decking.

chairStyle.description: How the seats around a table look.

kind.description: chair, armchair, stool, bench, booth, bistro (rattan bistro chair), cafe (bentwood), tub (rounded tub chair), lounge (low lounge chair), stool_backrest (stool with back), pouf.

externalRef.description: A record in an external system (POS, reservations, BMS/IoT, inventory …) that this object corresponds to.

id.description: The record's id in that system.

type.description: Optional record type in that system (table, area, device …).

description: Platform-independent floor plan for restaurants, cafes, bars and similar venues. Structure is validated by this schema; references and geometry are validated by the reference validator (python/eaterior). Live table state and sensor readings live outside the plan.
